block_report.rule_applied: Every figure names a source and a date, or the field stays 'unknown'. No estimate, no interpolation, no inference from a neighbouring event or a country total. Where a value is a logical consequence of a sourced statement rather than a figure read off the page, it carries an explicit 'derivation' string; where a source gives only a month, the field carries precision:'month'. Both are recorded so the step is visible downstream rather than invisible.
block_report.gate_note: EXPOSURE_REGISTRATION section 5 requires 30 COMPLETE across all six blocks before Stage 1 issues a verdict. This block contributes what it contributes; no field was filled to raise the count.
block_report.note_on_zeros: Zero is written only where a source establishes that nothing was taken offline - Abqaiq, where the attack was stopped about a mile from the nearest facility. It is NOT written for the Hormuz threat, where no source opened says whether transits changed. An unsourced zero is as much a guess as an unsourced magnitude, and it would be worse here because it reads as a measurement.
